statement: Showing intentions before a scoped vision purchase makes foresight relevant while preserving a meaningful decision to conserve power.
test_method: Inspect contemporaneous drafts, purchases, authored reasons and final choices in a scoped five-player plus facilitator run; reproduce consequences separately.
supporting_outcomes: A selected answer addresses a live uncertainty and is cited in changed orders or bargaining.
An available purchase is deliberately declined to preserve leverage.
contradicting_outcomes: Selected answers repeatedly miss considered decisions.
Players cannot distinguish confirmation from changed action.
evidence_requirements: Original player decisions before and after disclosure.
